publicChrome.footerBody: Ulwazi lukawonke-wonke olulungiselelwe ababoneleli-nkonzo, abathengi, abalingane abalingwayo kunye nabachaphazelekayo ekuthengeni izinto. Amaphepha omthetho kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo aqulathe ulwimi lobuchwephesha kwaye ayizongcebiso zokugqibela zomthetho.

home.headline: Apho ababoneleli baseMzantsi Afrika badibana nokuthenga kokwenene.
home.intro: Bhrawuza ngokuzenzekelayo iithenda zoluntu kunye ne-RFQs ngoshishino, iphondo kunye nomhla wokuvala-kunye namakhonkco kwimithombo yoqobo.
home.sourceNote: Amathuba kawonke-wonke afunyenwe kuluhlu lwempahla esemthethweni.
home.supplierBody: Fumana amathuba. Qinisekisa. Khulisa ishishini lakho.
home.smartScoreBody: Yakhelwe kubungqina bokuthotyelwa obuhlaziyiweyo kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwebhanki.
home.buyerBody: Umthombo wabathengisi abaqinisekisiweyo. Thumela i-RFQs. Lawula ucaphulo.
home.statsBody: Amathuba akhoyo ngoku avela kwii-eTenders zikarhulumente ezisemthethweni, zivavanyelwa ngokuzenzekelayo izaziso ezicinyiweyo okanye esele zinikezelwe.
home.network: Uthungelwano lokuthengwa kwempahla noMzantsi Afrika belulindile.
home.supplierPoint1: Dwelisa ishishini lakho. Faka inombolo yakho ye-CSD kunye nesatifikethi se-B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Fumana i-SmartScore-inqanaba lakho lokuthembela, elibonakalayo kuye wonke umthengi.
home.supplierPoint3: Ii-RFQ ezihambelanayo ziza kuwe. Azisekho iintsuku zokuvala eziphosiweyo.
home.verified48: Iqinisekiswe kwiiyure ezingama-48. Akukho khadi letyala.
home.smartScoreIntro: Umniki-nkonzo ngamnye uphethe i-SmartScore-ijongiwe ngokuchasene nemithombo esemthethweni emine yoMzantsi Afrika, ihlolwe liqela lethu.
home.smartScoreRank: Amanqaku angama-90 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye iprofayile yakho ihlala kuqala kukhangelo lomthengi.
home.buyerPoint1: Thumela i-RFQ kwimizuzu emihlanu. Seta imfuneko yakho ye-B-BBEE, iphondo, kunye noluhlu lwexabiso.
home.buyerPoint3: Thelekisa ucaphulo ngapha nangapha-nganye iphethe i-SmartScore kunye nebheji yokuqinisekisa.
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC kunye nobungqina bebhanki-buhlaziywe liqela lethu ngaphambi kokuba kuvele nawuphi na umboneleli.
home.trustMatchingBody: Amathuba avulelekileyo ahambelana neeprofayili zababoneleli ngoshishino olubhalisiweyo kunye nephondo.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Ababoneleli baya kwaziswa kwimizuzu nje embalwa yokuba i-RFQ ithunyelwe.
home.trustAuditBody: Zonke iikowuti, ibhaso, kunye nentengiselwano ifakiwe kwaye ithunyelwa ngaphandle kuphicotho lokuthengwa kwempahla.

opportunities.registerRespondBody: Yenza i-akhawunti yomthengisi wasimahla ukungenisa iikowuti, ulandelele imihla ebekiweyo, kwaye ufikelele kuzo zonke iithenda ezisebenzayo kwi-AiForm Procure.
opportunities.ctaTitle: Phendula kwiithenda kwaye uphumelele izivumelwano ezininzi
opportunities.ctaBody: Joyina amawakawaka ababoneleli baseMzantsi Afrika abaqinisekisiweyo—ngenisa iikowuti, ulungelelaniswe namathuba, kwaye ukhulise ishishini lakho ku-AiForm Procure.
opportunities.screenedHelp: Olu luhlu luphumelele uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo lwezaziso ezicinyiweyo okanye esele zinikezelwe-jonga iZiko leTrasti malunga nokuba ukukhangela amathuba asebenza njani.
opportunities.sourceExplanation: Amathuba afunyanwa kwizaziso zokuthengwa kwempahla karhulumente kunye nee-RFQ eziposwe ngeqonga. Idatha ihlaziywa rhoqo ngexesha lokulinga.
opportunities.guestBody: Yenza i-akhawunti yasimahla ukungenisa iikowuti kwaye ufumane ii-RFQ ezihambelanayo.
opportunities.weeklyNoAccount: Fumana olu luhlu nge-imeyile kuwe ngeveki, akukho akhawunti ifunekayo.
opportunities.privacyNote: Siyayihlonipha imfihlo yakho. Zikhuphe kubhaliso nangaliphi na ixesha.
